what: The background of bordered text boxes (logo, title words, page buttons) is a color-paper slanted at −36°. Every 1.8s the next color chip in the palette slides in from the right over 1s, covers the previous color and settles. Giving each box a different --fx-delay (.15 · .3 · .45s) makes the words take on color one after another so the slanted color edge flows across the boxes. When the scene changes, sending a color index with fx:chip switches to that color (from the left if the index is lower).

options.[data-fx-part=chip]: Background piece inside the box (required) — text sits on top of it (z-index 1)
options.colors: Stone palette variable names separated by spaces (default --kf-accent --kf-accent-soft --kf-ink-soft) — the original uses the colors of scene eight
options.when: If manual, it does not turn on its own and changes only via the fx:chip event (detail.index)
options.--fx-delay · --fx-dur: Per-piece delay · entry duration (via style), default 0s · 1s
options.--fx-h: Box height (via style) — when widening the slices by the tilt, default 100%

from.where: shared.js ky.tip · index.js color cycle (original colortip — .colortipUnit translates 100%→0 1s var(--delay) inside a skewX(-36deg) plate, fixed to the background color on animationend, setInterval 1800ms · on scene change changeFrame applies that section’s color)
